## Alerts watchdog (TEST, inactive)
Every 10 minutes reads GET /healthz/alerts on the dashboard. If no alert check has succeeded for 20 minutes (or the dashboard does not answer), emails raflak@gmail.com, then hourly while it lasts, and once on recovery. Times only, no visit data. Cannot detect n8n itself being down: pair with an outside uptime monitor on the same URL.
